returns.name: Form NYS-45, Quarterly Combined Withholding, Wage Reporting, and Unemployment Insurance Return
contents: Employers subject to both UI contributions and withholding tax complete Parts A, B and C (boxes a through j) each quarter.
Employers subject only to UI complete Part A and Part C (boxes a-f) and enter zeros in withholding fields that do not apply.
Employers subject only to withholding complete Part B and Part C (boxes a-e and g-j) and enter zeros in UI fields that do not apply.
Employers with no payroll for the quarter complete Parts A and B and enter 0 in Part C, line 24.
Complete wage information (Part C) for all employees each calendar quarter.

notModelled: The NYS-45 part and box layout and the flat-file format (Publication 72.5) were not read.
UI contribution rate notices are inputs; NY auto-populates a rate (the instructions describe the 9.9% example) and adjusts later, which is not modelled.
